name: coder
description: Implement code changes for final review.

implement.description: Implement, verify, and summarize the change.
implement.promptTemplate:
Task:
{{input}}

Implement the task. Append `## Implementation Summary` to {{artifactPath}} with changes, commit SHAs, verification results, and unresolved issues.

In `coder-review`, when `CORTEX_TASK_ID` is set, do not run `cortex-task complete` or mark the owning task done. Leave it claimed for the final reviewer.
